$comment: MANUAL accessibility test records — the half of the picture axe cannot produce. axe-core reports what a machine can check on a rendered story; it cannot tell you whether a screen reader announces a component usefully, or whether the tab order makes sense. Those are human passes, and this file is where a human records one. Read by apps/docs/src/lib/a11y.mjs and rendered in the per-component checks panel.
$rules: This file is a RECORD STORE, not a component list. Components are enumerated from the custom elements manifest; a component with no key here renders as NOT RECORDED, which is the truth.
Never add an entry for a test that was not actually run. An empty file is honest; an optimistic one is worse than no panel at all.
`date` is the day the pass was performed. `tool` names the screen reader and browser used. `result` is 'pass' or 'fail'.

screenReader.notes: Name, role and disabled state all announced.

keyboard.notes: Reachable by Tab, activates on Enter and Space, visible focus ring.
